_meta.note: Fictional mock data for testing the Converge and Roam engines. Venue names are invented; areas and MRT stations are real; coordinates are approximate. Member dietary needs and budgets are invented for testing, edit freely.

units.exposure: 0 = linked to the MRT, 5 = open air with a long walk

_meta.dietRule: diet.halal / vegetarian / vegan are 'full' | 'options' | 'none'. A venue passes a member's hard dietary filter if the value is 'full' or 'options'. 'full' can earn a ranking bonus. Activities have diet = null and skip dietary filters.
_meta.antiRepeat: suggested: penalty 100 if visited within 14 days, falling linearly to 0 at 60 days. Use visitHistory.
_meta.occasionFit: Precomputed from attributes x profiles weights (sum of weight x attribute). Replace with your review-scan + user-tag scores later.
_meta.priceSensitivity: Per occasion multiplier on the price weight: a date or birthday is a splurge (0.3 to 0.5), study is budget-driven (1.5).
_meta.mockTravel: mockTravelMinutes = 6 + haversine_km x 1.35 x 60 / 22. A stand-in for OneMap routing so tests are deterministic.
_meta.weatherRule: penalty = rainRisk x (exposure / 5) x 100 for the venue forecastArea in the chosen weatherCase.

scenarios.name: Birthday dinner, everyone, mixed diets
scenarios.expect: Hard filters leave 7 venues that serve halal AND vegetarian AND vegan (v04, v06, v12, v22, v25, v26, v28). Midpoint is in Bishan, so only v25, v26 and v28 fall inside the 3km cap.

scenarios.name: Date night, clear weather
scenarios.expect: Faith starts at SMU, Darryl at his office. Midpoint is near Fort Canning, so romantic venues v01, v05, v14 are all within 1km and should rank high.

scenarios.name: Date night, rainy
scenarios.expect: Same as S02 but the outdoor rooftop bar (v14) must score worse and rank lower than in S02.

scenarios.name: Study session at 3pm, sockets and quiet needed
scenarios.expect: Only venues with sockets and noise 2 or below (v08, v20). Study fit should put v08 and v20 on top.

scenarios.name: Late lunch at 3pm (time-of-day edge case)
scenarios.expect: Same area as S02. Venues closed at 15:00 (split-hours v01, v05 and v11 which closes 14:30) must NOT appear, even though they would at 19:00.

scenarios.name: Midpoint lands in a nature reserve (empty midpoint)
scenarios.expect: Nothing within 500m and nothing within 1km of the midpoint. First hit is v22 Springleaf, so the radius must expand: 2km step with a plain centroid (1.1km away), 3km step with the default fairness-weighted midpoint (2.6km away, because Darius and Jonathan carry travel debt).

scenarios.name: No venue satisfies every constraint
scenarios.expect: Halal + vegan + $7 or less pp + step-free leaves ZERO venues. The app must say which constraint to relax, not show a blank screen.

scenarios.name: Opt-out recalculation (S01 without Darius)
scenarios.expect: Midpoint moves east and the halal constraint disappears, so more venues pass and the result list changes.

scenarios.name: Someone starts elsewhere, someone ends elsewhere
scenarios.expect: Faith starts at SMU, Ian ends at a friend's place. Return-trip check must use Ian's override end, not home.

roamScenarios.name: Roam from Bugis after eating
roamScenarios.expect: v04 (just visited) is not suggested. Halal applies to food only, activities still appear (a02, a04). All results open at 14:45.

roamScenarios.name: Roam in Punggol, rainy
roamScenarios.expect: Outdoor promenade (a03) must score worse in rain than in clear weather.
